# Package names from OpenWrt 25.12.4's official feeds (x86_64, the distfeeds.list the
# openwrt/rootfs:x86-64-25.12.4 image ships) that hold anything other than lowercase letters,
# digits and '-': upper case, '.', '_'. Read on 2026-10-09 with
#   apk --repositories-file <distfeeds> update; apk query --fields name --available '*'
# 11188 names in all; these 214 are the ones a narrower grammar would refuse. No name in that
# index holds '+', ':', '/', '=', '@' or '..', or ends in .apk. TestApkNameAcceptsEveryUnusualOfficialName
# requires apk_add to accept every one of them.
